themes.title: A death in the family
themes.situation: Someone I love has died and I do not know how to carry an ordinary day.

themes.title: Grief that will not lift
themes.situation: The loss was a long time ago and everyone expects me to be better by now.

themes.title: A child I am afraid for
themes.situation: My child is in trouble or in danger and I cannot protect them from it.

themes.title: A diagnosis
themes.situation: I have been told something about my body that I am frightened of.

themes.title: Caring for someone who is failing
themes.situation: I am looking after someone whose condition only goes one way, and I am tired.

themes.title: Money running out
themes.situation: I do not know how I will pay for what my family needs.

themes.title: Losing work
themes.situation: The work that gave my days their shape has been taken away.

themes.title: Work that feels pointless
themes.situation: I work hard at something that seems to matter to nobody, including me.

themes.title: A marriage ending
themes.situation: The person I built my life with and I are coming apart.

themes.title: Estranged from family
themes.situation: Someone in my family will not speak to me and I do not know how to reach them.

themes.title: Betrayed by a friend
themes.situation: Someone I trusted completely has turned out not to be who I thought.

themes.title: Loneliness
themes.situation: I go through most days without anyone really knowing how I am.

themes.title: Treated unjustly
themes.situation: Something unfair was done to me and nobody with power seems to care.

themes.title: Powerless against a system
themes.situation: I am fighting an institution that will outlast me and does not notice me.

themes.title: Watching cruelty and unable to stop it
themes.situation: I can see people being harmed and there is nothing I can do about it.

themes.title: Doubt
themes.situation: I am not sure any of what I believed is true, and I cannot say so out loud.

themes.title: Feeling far away
themes.situation: I pray and it is like speaking into an empty room.

themes.title: Angry at God
themes.situation: Something happened that I cannot forgive, and I blame the God I still believe in.

themes.title: Coming back after a long time away
themes.situation: I left all this behind years ago and I do not know if I can return.

themes.title: Something I did
themes.situation: I did something I am ashamed of and I cannot undo it.

themes.title: Addiction
themes.situation: I keep going back to the thing that is destroying me.

themes.title: Forgiving myself
themes.situation: Other people have forgiven me and I cannot manage it myself.

themes.title: Someone I need to forgive
themes.situation: Someone hurt me badly and I am being asked, or asking myself, to let it go.

themes.title: Waiting for something that may not come
themes.situation: I have been hoping for the same thing for years with no sign of it.

themes.title: Exhaustion
themes.situation: I am not in crisis. I am just very tired and have been for a long time.

themes.title: Starting again
themes.situation: Something ended and I have to build a life from the beginning.

themes.title: Leaving home
themes.situation: I am going somewhere far away and do not know when I will return.

themes.title: A new child
themes.situation: A baby has arrived and I am overwhelmed by love and by fear at the same time.

themes.title: Recovery
themes.situation: Something that was broken in me is slowly mending.

themes.title: Unexpected kindness
themes.situation: A stranger did something for me that they did not have to do.

themes.title: Gratitude
themes.situation: Things are well and I want to say so to someone.

themes.title: Fear of what is coming
themes.situation: Nothing bad has happened yet and I cannot stop bracing for it.

themes.title: Advent · waiting in the dark
themes.situation: I am waiting for something that has not come, and I am asked to keep the light on anyway.

themes.title: Advent · the promise is slow
themes.situation: What I was promised is taking so long that I have started to doubt I heard it right.

themes.title: Christmas · God arrives small
themes.situation: Something enormous has happened quietly, at night, to people nobody was watching.

themes.title: Christmas · no room
themes.situation: There was nowhere for us, and we made do in a place not meant for it.

themes.title: Epiphany · strangers understood first
themes.situation: People from outside saw what those closest to it could not.

themes.title: Lent · going without on purpose
themes.situation: I am giving something up and finding out how much I depended on it.

themes.title: Lent · in the wilderness
themes.situation: I am in an empty stretch with nothing to distract me from what I actually want.

themes.title: Lent · turning back
themes.situation: I know what I need to stop doing and I have not stopped.

themes.title: Holy Week · the night before
themes.situation: I know what is coming tomorrow and I cannot make it not come.

themes.title: Holy Week · abandoned
themes.situation: The people who said they would stay have gone, and I am on my own in it.

themes.title: Easter · the stone moved
themes.situation: Something I had given up on has turned out not to be finished.

themes.title: Easter · slow to believe it
themes.situation: Good news has arrived and I cannot let myself trust it yet.

themes.title: Pentecost · sent out
themes.situation: I am being asked to go and say something, and I do not feel ready.

themes.title: Ordinary Time · the long middle
themes.situation: Nothing is wrong and nothing is remarkable, and I have to keep going anyway.
